python_crate_unit_tests.detail: The minimal Debian image has no libpython3.11 development/link library. Installing python3-dev was attempted, but the container could not reach apt sources. Linking failed on unresolved Python C API symbols.

limitations: Linux Python extension build passed, but qx-python Rust unit tests require libpython3.11-dev in the container.
